description: Search Corcoran listings by region with price, bedroom, bathroom, property-type, status and location filters; look up listings by ID or URL; or browse the region directory.

citiesOrBoroughs.description: City or borough names, e.g. `Manhattan`, `Brooklyn`, `Miami Beach`.
citiesOrBoroughs.title: Cities or boroughs

includeDetails.description: Fetch each listing's detail page for description, features, year built, taxes, days on market and building info. Costs one extra request per listing.
includeDetails.title: Enrich each listing with detail data

listingIds.description: Listing IDs or full Corcoran listing URLs for mode=byIds. Example: `109473943` or `https://www.corcoran.com/listing/for-sale/.../109473943`.
listingIds.title: Listing IDs or URLs

listingStatus.description: Limit to a status. Sold and Rented search recent history; use Sold/rented window to widen it.
listingStatus.title: Listing status

maxBathrooms.description: Only listings with at most this many bathrooms.
maxBathrooms.title: Max bathrooms

maxBedrooms.description: Only listings with at most this many bedrooms.
maxBedrooms.title: Max bedrooms

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted listings. Larger caps page through Corcoran's search results.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Only listings priced at most this much. Leave empty for no maximum.
maxPrice.title: Max price (USD)

minBathrooms.description: Only listings with at least this many bathrooms.
minBathrooms.title: Min bathrooms

minBedrooms.description: Only listings with at least this many bedrooms.
minBedrooms.title: Min bedrooms

minPrice.description: Only listings priced at least this much. Leave empty for no minimum.
minPrice.sectionDescription: All filters are applied by Corcoran's search API, so they work across pagination.
minPrice.title: Min price (USD)

mode.description: Search listings, look up exact listings by ID or URL, or browse the region directory.
enumTitles: Look up listings by ID or URL
mode.sectionDescription: Pick a mode, then fill the fields that mode uses.
mode.title: Mode

neighborhoods.description: Neighborhood names, e.g. `Upper East Side`, `Chelsea`. Leave empty for the whole region.
neighborhoods.sectionDescription: Narrow a region by neighborhood, city/borough or ZIP code.
neighborhoods.title: Neighborhoods

openHouseDays.description: Only listings with an open house on these upcoming days (0 = today, 1 = tomorrow, ... 6). Leave empty to ignore open-house dates.
openHouseDays.title: Open-house days

propertyTypes.description: Limit to one or more property types. Leave empty for every type.
propertyTypes.title: Property types

regionId.description: Corcoran region ID for search mode. `1` = New York City, `2` = South Florida, `3` = The Hamptons, `100` = Northern California, `103` = Chicago, `109` = Denver, `128` = Nashville, `133` = Houston, `137` = Boston, `141` = Washington Metro Area. Use mode=browseRegions for the full list.
regionId.title: Region ID

regionIds.description: Search several regions in one run. When set, this replaces Region ID. Example: `1, 2, 3` for NYC, South Florida and the Hamptons.
regionIds.title: Region IDs (multiple)

searchQuery.description: Free-text search handled by Corcoran, e.g. an address, building or neighborhood.
searchQuery.title: Search keyword

soldRentedWindowDays.description: How far back to search when Listing status is Sold or Rented. Ignored for other statuses.
soldRentedWindowDays.title: Sold/rented window (days)

sortBy.description: Order of listings before the item cap is applied.
sortBy.sectionDescription: Control ordering, enrichment and the run size.
sortBy.title: Sort order

title: Corcoran Real Estate Listings Scraper Input
